text_block_list.text:
The sea! The blue sky! Summer training camp! Faced with an
unmissable chance for growth, I'm fired up even more than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What lovely weather~ It makes me want to take a nap on the sand.
Now then, we have just one more sprint remaining, yes~?

Mejiro Bright was her usual self, but
she seemed to be enjoying herself, and her training was going smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall leave the timing to you~.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me! Ready... start!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huuup~...!

After this, I'll let Mejiro Bright rest while I adjust the training regimen.
Then we have strength training in the sea.
And then after that, we need to—

...ner?
...Trai-ner?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trai-ner~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have been back for quite a while now~.
Whatever is the matter? You seemed to be lost in a da~ze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, Trainer. You were staying up late last night
preparing batches of nutritional drinks for me, weren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Staaaare.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have decided.
Trainer, would you care to visit the festival with me this evening~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
One of the staff at the lodging mentioned it earlier, you see~.
They said there will be a festival nearby starting from the evening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It sounds as though many of the other horsegirls are going, too.
So why don't we take things easy today and—

If we're going to enjoy the festival together, I need to wrap up the rest of my work!
First, let's get this training regimen restructured!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, sorting through your documents so briskly and quickly~...
choice_data_list: All right, let's take a quick break!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, there they go. Taking a break is fine and well, but
I wonder if you will actually get any proper rest, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Alri~ght. I shall simply have to take matters into my own hands~.

By the time I finished handling various tasks and even wrapped up
scouting the forest trail for tomorrow's practice, dusk was already falling.
choice_data_list: Ah... It's already this late? I've gotta head back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, welcome back~.
Come, come. Please, have a seat right here next to me.

I still had other things to do...
Even as I voiced my protest, I sat down, and Mejiro Bright gave a gentle, relaxed smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you have only just returned, have you not?
There are ever so many things I wish to chat about today~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
During our break, Dober and I played along the rocky shore.
And while we were there, a purple sea slug was~—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Further out in the open water, jellyfish were gently floating along.
I watched them from the shore in a pleasant, quiet da~ze~.

My body had grown far more exhausted than I'd realized,
and her slow, soothing voice began to soak deep into me.
I can't... I still have paperwork to put together—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Cumulonimbus clouds bigger than mountains floated up and melted away,
looking just like soft-serve ice cream, you kno~w...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, are you getting 'sleepy'?
Please, do not hold back—rest and drift off to sleep as lo~ng as you like~.

text_block_list.name: Someone's Humming
text_block_list.text: Hmm~, hm-hm-hm, hm-hm-hmm~♪

What reached my ears as I drifted in drowsiness was a serene melody.
A soothing, tranquil hum, like a lullaby I'd heard long ago.

text_block_list.name: Someone's Humming
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hmm~... Hm-hm-hm, hm-hm-hmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You have awoken already?
You really could have rested for much longer, you know.

I scrambled to sit up.
Without even realizing it, I'd fallen asleep on the lobby couch...!

The documents I had to turn in, the festival we were supposed to go to—
As I frantically checked my schedule, Mejiro Bright spoke up at an easy pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The documents... Those are for the camp staff, yes?
I asked them if tomorrow would be all right~, and they said it was no trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And as for the festival, I thought that perhaps we need not rush off to it~?
After all, there is always next year, isn't there~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Did I overstep just a little bit, I wonder~?
I did end up rearranging your schedule on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no need to thank me for anything~.
After all, I was just taking it nice and easy, same as always.

It's true, I might have been overworking myself a bit...
Thanks to letting me sleep, I can feel my energy returning.

If she hadn't let me relax like this,
there's a good chance I would've been too exhausted to even make it to the festival.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, we found our pace again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Our pace...?
You mean... yours and mine, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Yes... yes. I suppose... being a "slow and steady soul" suits me best of all, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look over there, Trainer.
It seems that grilled carrot stall is still open for business.

Arriving at the festival venue long after everyone else,
the grounds were indeed quiet, and the crowds seemed to be thinning out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It looks like many of the stalls have already packed up, but...
As the saying goes, "Fortune comes to those who take what's left!"
choice_data_list: Is that how the saying goes...?

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, little lady! Care to try your luck at the raffle?
There's only one ticket left, and I'd love to wrap up for the night!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, what a lovely leftover that is~.
Hehehe, well then, if you don't mind—

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Bingo! You hit the grand prize!
Here's your prize. A brooch that's just perfect for a lovely lady like you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness~!! Hehehe~.
It's shaped like a flower, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...You know, Trainer. It truly seems...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If you wait long enough, flowers really do bloom.

After that, the two of us enjoyed the winding-down festival together.
Slowly, leisurely... keeping strictly to our own pace.
